A01: Four primary concerns; proposed architecture; selective deeper context after a detected signal.
A02: Genesys Cloud → Authenticate OAuth → Create Notification Channel → Subscribe to Required Topics → Genesys WebSocket → multiplexed events → demultiplex by conversation_id.
A03: Demultiplex using conversation identifier; normalize internal transcript contract; publish to internal conversation stream.
A04: Connector → normalization → keyed internal stream → partitions → workers → conversation context.
A05: Bounded context; deterministic and semantic paths; embedding → vector search → classifier; signal evidence → resolution → detected signal.
A06: Deterministic sufficient; selective semantic processing; independent evaluation when semantics inherently required; also standalone classifier path.
A07: Initial engineering latency targets, not production SLAs.
A08: POC scope; stage P50/P95/P99; event traceability; no final end-to-end SLA.
A09: POC sources → connector → event mapper → context buffer; signal catalog → rule families → resolution → signal events → workbench / optional store.
A10: Signal output and POC success criteria; eventual selective contextual reasoning → activation.
S01: Microbuffered input → normalize → entity extraction; found: async context update; missing: cache lookup; enrich → detection. Direct normalized-to-deterministic dotted path also shown.
S02: Semantic, classifier and deterministic branches; top-K → BGE Reranker; async training storage; combined results and classifier → resolution.
S03: Resolution → signal detected? → yes: publish via SSE / WebSocket → downstream consumers.
M01: Meeting supplied in chat; date and speakers not provided. Excerpts indexed M01.1–M01.8.
M02: Second user-supplied meeting continuation; actual date/speakers unknown. M02.1–M02.7.
U02: User direction outside quoted meeting: continue brainstorming and records; do not modify/design architecture diagram now; final design later.
M03: Third meeting continuation; M03.1–M03.6. Three scenario types; proposed domain scoping; exact business labels unresolved.
M04: Fourth meeting continuation: interface concurrency, signal definition/management, metadata applicability, execution microbatches, same-call memory and proposed signal composition.
M05: Latest implementation discussion, M05.1–M05.10; date of meeting not independently established.
U05: User explicitly requests consolidated/finalized layered diagram now; earlier hold lifted.
P01: Signal Catalog Data Model Planning; Domain → Group → Signal and candidate fields.
P02: Remaining candidate signal attributes, example refs, version and lifecycle status.
P03: Example entity/context extraction, candidate narrowing, deterministic value checks and omission behavior.
P04: Semantic examples/threshold retrieval and LLM review of candidate against requirement/context.
P05: Signal Manager config, Call Ingestor, Context Cache, Signal Detector, three strategies, Vector DB, detected signal and BigQuery persistence.
P06: Proposed credit impact, fees/pricing, rewards/benefits scenario families and source spreadsheet names.
P07: Proposed spending/payment/employee features; All_NoPresetSpending Limit and transfer-to-digital source labels; taxonomy example.
U06: User clarifies separate emulator module/service; BigQuery reference-design option for now.
